config.metric_note: PageHit=source page provenance; TableHit=source table index; EvidenceHit=legacy value+context_keys in one display chunk; prompt proxy measures concatenated evidence only; no generated LLM

prompt_token_metrics.policy: Full chunks in rank order; stop before first oversized chunk; no skipping/splitting; exact cl100k_base encoding of concatenated display text with fixed separator

config.ablation_note: Field-level factorial ablations: caption removes caption_text + its literal contribution from derived abstract (other abstract facts retained); context removes before/after only; abstract-only separately. Prefix-off changes only embedding retrieval prefixes. Cross-field semantic overlaps separately reported, not silently erased.
config.latency_note: Docling parsed once; hybrid and EU chunk sequential; embedding/ranking sequential, no strict isolated CPU/GPU benchmark.

observed_input_sizes.note: Successful observed sizes only: NOT official upper or lower support bounds.

ablation_overlap_note: An identical span in an independent field is a semantic overlap, not proof that the ablation code failed.
token_length_diagnostic_note: Evenly spaced sample of at most 256 retrieval vectors per PDF/arm; counts indicate risk of encoder truncation, not proven causal effect.

notes: Shared PDF parse once per document, not counted five times in actual runtime
Model loading, package installation, QA dataset construction excluded
All timings sequential; repeated execution may benefit from cached models
Do not claim isolated end-to-end latency comparisons from these stage timings

measurement.excluded: System instructions, user question, chat template, citation wrapper, generated answer, actual API billing
measurement.budget_policy: Take ranked unique chunks in order; STOP before first chunk that exceeds the total context-only budget. No splitting, skipping, summarization, or reranking.
measurement.full_chunk_constraint: An oversized top1 chunk yields zero selected chunks for that budget.
measurement.prompt_hit: Existing value plus all context_keys appear anywhere in CONCATENATED retrieved context; they may occur in different chunks (proxy, not answer correctness).
measurement.single_chunk_hit: At least one individually returned display chunk passes the unmodified EvidenceHit value+context_keys rule.
measurement.token_saving_claim: Not established unless compared at matched success/coverage and budget.
